Product Features

  • Compact Size: With a size of 70 x 35 x 180 cm, it does not take up too much space in the living room, but offers extensive storage and display functions, and is suitable for a variety of living layouts.
  • Divided storage space: 3 levels in the large cabinet door, 2 levels in the small cabinet door, also the semi-open storage space is divided into 3 levels by tempered glass partitions. The multi-layer partition design allows for categorized storage of books, ornaments, collections, etc. to meet different storage needs.
  • Convenient Switch: The cabinet door has a rebound switch. By pressing lightly, the cabinet door can be opened gently. The operation is simple and labor-saving, ensuring a relaxed user experience.
  • Hidden Drawer: It has a drawer for storing small items. Small items such as remote controls and batteries are easily hidden to keep the display case clean and tidy.
  • Smart Lighting: Equipped with LED light strips controlled by a mobile phone app, the color and brightness of the light can be freely adjusted to create a warm, romantic or cool atmosphere, making the items in the display case look even more attractive under the light.
  • High-gloss structure: The high-gloss design of the front enhances the exclusivity and shine of the display case, making it a special eye-catcher in the living room and highlighting the elegant taste.
  • Reliable Material: Made of chipboard with a total load capacity of 45kg, it is sturdy and durable, can provide stable support for items in the cabinet, and ensures safety in daily use.
  • Easy to clean: The high-gloss surface is smooth and easy to clean. Dust and stains can be removed by wiping lightly, which will keep the display case looking like new for a long time.
  • Functional aesthetics: This display cabinet perfectly combines storage, presentation, lighting and other functions with a stylish appearance. It is not only a practical household item, but also an artistic ornament in the living room, which adds quality and style to life at home.
  • NOTE: This product consists of two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before you start assembling!
